### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**2** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f963d8e2b32b11be6d8d50d3134e4f3ee888e16a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4d6443fc78666b7382e8179bb6eb8a6ad397d264` — the merge of head `939c8ac1a7fa3f14259029ef662f6d82c2f4ad5d` into base `f963d8e2b32b11be6d8d50d3134e4f3ee888e16a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4d6443fc78666b7382e8179bb6eb8a6ad397d264 && git checkout 4d6443fc78666b7382e8179bb6eb8a6ad397d264
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f963d8e2b32b11be6d8d50d3134e4f3ee888e16a 939c8ac1a7fa3f14259029ef662f6d82c2f4ad5d && git checkout -B drift-repro f963d8e2b32b11be6d8d50d3134e4f3ee888e16a && git merge --no-ff 939c8ac1a7fa3f14259029ef662f6d82c2f4ad5d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f963d8e2b32b11be6d8d50d3134e4f3ee888e16a
```

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `939c8ac1a7fa3f14259029ef662f6d82c2f4ad5d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/export-json-fields.test.ts, .changeset/24183-export-json-fields.md + packages/rest/src/export-format.ts, packages/spec/src/api/contract.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts, packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/task.object.ts, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, objectui packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx, objectui packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, objectui packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts

PR #24206 on card #24183, narrowing face · `domain:cli` seat 2 · session `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb`

**Inputs:** the card body and all five comments (triage 6236168153, claim 6237380493, reports 6238180833 and 6238602315, seat decision 6238218754); the PR body, its file list (3 files, +266/−3) and the net diff against `main` (merge base 8a88901be; the three-dot diff against current main f7af83945 is the same 3-file diff); the head's check-runs. Read-only: no worktree, build, test, gate or ablation was run; the two ablations are the dev's reports, not re-run here.

**Check-runs on the head, read at 2026-10-17T18:43Z:** 47 check-runs, 39 success, 8 skipped (paths-filtered: Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood pair, Temporal Conformance, Packed-tarball smoke, one Auto Label and one Check PR Size), 0 failure, 0 in progress. All five required contexts are `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (every shard, 1/6 to 6/6), Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard. Check Changeset is `success` on both of its runs on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set or served-set change the diff implies, each judged:

1. **Served-set narrowing at `GET /api/v1/data/:object/export` with `format=json` and `?fields=`** — each row now carries exactly the named keys, in list order (data-action-routes.ts :166 `pickExportKeys`, :986 `fieldsExplicit`, :1212 the pick before `formatRowForJson`). **Right.** It is the route's pre-existing declaration honoured (`fields=a,b,c` was declared for every format with no caveat; at the head the doc comment :770–775 states what each format does with it), the same resolved list the CSV and XLSX arms write, and consistent with the spec: `ExportRequestSchema` (contract.zod.ts :420) is `QuerySchema` intersected with `{ format }`, and `QuerySchema.fields` (query.zod.ts :519) reads "Fields to retrieve". The one named producer (objectui ListView.tsx :4848–4870 and ObjectGrid.tsx :4552–4570, through data-objectstack `exportDownload` :5009–5016, which serialises `fields` as a comma list) sends the view's visible columns and only downloads the blob; no consumer in this repo (packages/cli, packages/client, examples, content/docs, skills) sends `format=json` with `fields` and reads a key it did not name. Pinned through the real route (test :149, :157, :178, :189).

2. **An explicit list is never narrowed or reordered after `fieldsExplicit`** (the hunk's claim at :983–986). **Right, read in the code:** the hidden-field default runs only under `!fields || fields.length === 0` (:1022), the security-service projection only under `fieldsFromSchema` (:1071), the first-row derivation only under `!fields` (:1156), and the masked-row fallback only under `!readableProjected && fieldsFromSchema` (:1171). So the JSON arm reads the one resolved column list and defines no second one.

3. **A named key the read did not return is absent from the JSON row, never written as `null`** (:166–176, :1202–1209; changeset line 15). **Right.** The read middleware deletes unreadable keys (the FieldMasker note at :1159–1170) and the read strips the `__search` companion; `pickExportKeys` keeps only own keys whose value is not `undefined`, so a stored `null` is still written as `null` and only absence is absence. CSV and XLSX write an empty cell for the same name (export-format.ts :390–397 `formatRowCells`); the doc comment and the changeset both state the per-format difference, and the test pins both faces side by side (:168). The list door's `$select` answers the same way for the same reason — the dev's scratch probe, not pinned here and not needed, since the FieldMasker note in this file already states it.

4. **Values keep the export's readable formatting and keys keep list order after the pick** (changeset line 15; test :157). **Right:** `formatRowForJson` (export-format.ts :404–418) walks `Object.keys(row)` and formats only keys with metadata, adding none, so the insertion order `pickExportKeys` set is the output order; a lookup / user / reference field still resolves to a name because `$expand` nests the related record in the field's own value (export-format.ts :5–6, :346–351 `formatReference`), so no sibling key is needed and nothing is lost by picking first.

5. **`format=json` without `?fields=` is byte-identical to before** (PR body; changeset line 16). **Right:** the `rows[i]` arm at :1212 is the pre-existing statement, and `formatRowForJson` returns the original reference when nothing needs formatting. The route doc :775 now states it. The seat's decision (6238218754) is pinned at test :195 through the real route, `id` included, with an anti-vacuity check (the read carries the hidden `internal_code`; the CSV default header lacks `Internal Code`), so a cut to the CSV default would redden it.

6. **A hidden field named explicitly is served in JSON** (test :157 names `internal_code`). **Right** and consistent with the CSV arm: the #24143 hidden-field drop is column selection on the default only, and `metaMap` keeps every field (:1022–1037).

7. **Public surface:** `pickExportKeys` is module-private; `packages/rest` exports, `packages/spec`, `export-format.ts`, the import side and objectui are untouched; the route's OpenAPI `metadata` (:1263) is a summary only; `content/docs/references/api/export.mdx` is generated from `export.zod.ts`, which declares no per-format column rule; the QA checklist's export clause (records-forms.json :488) is about formats and filtered rows, not columns. **Right:** no doc surface, generated artifact or checklist item is owed by this diff.

8. Noted, no action: a name repeated in an explicit list (`fields=title,title`) yields two CSV columns and one JSON key — inherent to a JSON object, not a claim the diff makes.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/24183-export-json-fields.md` grades `'@objectstack/rest': minor` (line 2), declares `**BREAKING** (a served-set narrowing)` (line 11) and carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (line 7), the same line the PR body carries. **Matches what the diff publishes:** the only published source moved is `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`; fewer keys are served and no new key lands on any payload, so `no` with the `(narrowing)` arm is the well-formed reading under the Post-Task Checklist rule (`(narrowing)` is BREAKING), and the level is the one `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` prescribes for a declared narrowing during the launch window (`minor`; `major` is forbidden). Triage 6236168153 had written `yes (narrowing)`; the claim's `no (narrowing)` is the right reading, since clause ② is a new key on a published payload and this diff adds none. `Clause-②:` line: **right**.
- ADR-0087 disposition (changeset line 9, the adr-0087 marker): `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. **Right category:** nothing an author can write (spec key, export, option, config field, stored shape) is removed, renamed or re-shaped, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite and no FROM → TO mapping is owed; the body carries no rewrite prescription in arrow or table form (the closing "What changes for you" sentence is a note on request shape for an API caller, not a metadata migration); `runtime-interface-only` does not apply because no exported TS declaration changed. `check-adr-0087-registration` ran green on the head inside Check Changeset, and the dev's local run reads the same.
- `skip-changeset` would be wrong here and is not used. The title `fix(rest)!:` carries the bang.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (reports 6238180833 and 6238602315) and open questions, each answered:

- **open_questions[0], round 0 — which column set for no-`fields` JSON.** Answered by the seat's decision 6238218754 (keep the row as the read returns it) and closed in round 1 (`open_questions: []`). Judged, not adopted: the claim's premise (the CSV default contains `id` and every key the JSON re-import reads back) is measured false, and the measurement holds in the cited code — `showcase_task` (task.object.ts :20–120) declares no `id` field, so the 22-key default is the 18 declared fields plus the four readable audit and ownership columns; and the import runner (import-runner.ts :904–906) respects a supplied `id` on create and locates update and upsert targets by `matchFields` (:734–741; request parsing in import-prepare.ts :290–347), which is exactly why rows cut to that default re-import as duplicates under upsert on `id`. Against that, the CSV-default alternative is a silent duplication trap, the CSV-default-plus-`id` alternative is a second JSON-only definition of the export's columns (the defect class the claim fenced), and the `id`-in-every-format alternative widens the CSV and XLSX default that #24178 just set, out of this card's scope. The declared contract (`QuerySchema.fields` optional, "Fields to retrieve") already answers the no-`fields` case as no projection, so the decision rests on spec text, not on preference. The route doc and the test header state it; test :195 pins it. **Closed.**
- **Deviation: Done-when part 2 open at round 0.** Closed by round 1; the PR's first line is now `Fixes #24183`, and the "Part-of PR must not also close its card" and "The card this PR closes must claim this branch" checks are green on the head.
- **Deviation: `-- --maxWorkers=2` discarded by vitest (round 0).** No effect on scope (the whole package ran); round 1 ran without the bare separator. Noted.
- **Deviation: `test:repo` not run locally.** Test Core is green on all six shards on the head. Closed.
- **Deviation: whole-workspace build for the showcase measurement; worktree recreated in round 1; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first read exit 3 (prerequisite not met), then green after a full build.** Not a gate matter; Lint & Repo Gates is green on the head. Closed.
- **Deviation: changeset not edited in round 1.** Right: line 16 already states the no-`fields` answer and nothing in the file reads as open.
- **Deviation: one extra mutation run (the CSV-default cut) to prove the new pin can fail.** Within this review's read-only shape it is the dev's report; the gate verdict is the test's pass on the head. Noted.
- **Acceptance note 1 — the CSV and XLSX default carries no `id` on an object that declares none.** Matches the route's documented default (schema fields minus hidden), pre-dates #24178, and no named consumer needs CSV round-trip by `id`: noted, not filed, and not escalated here. The trigger to revisit is a named consumer.
- **Acceptance note 2 — CSV empty cell versus JSON absent key for a name the read did not return.** Stated in the doc comment and the changeset; judged right in ①.3.
- **Serial constraint and single-writer path.** #24178 merged before this claim (aaaeeac94); the "No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path" check is green on the head.
- **Governed surfaces:** none in the file list; this review is owed by the narrowing face alone.
- **Escalated:** nothing.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24183-export-json-fields`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

`domain:cli` seat 2 · `marchtian` · session `session_01QyoWKK9RwUNxBxmevy9Neb` · 2026-10-17T18:44Z · holder of claim 6237380493. The dev's reports are comments 6238180833 and 6238602315 on #24183, and the seat reviewed them against this PR, not the reports' own account.

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`. The first line is `Fixes #24183` (edited by the seat from `Part of` once decision D was pinned, along with the "Why" paragraph); it is the only closing keyword in the body. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is line-initial in the body, the changeset and the claim. The assignee is `marchtian`. 3 files: `data-action-routes.ts`, a new route-level test, one changeset. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 24206`: NOT governed, 269 changed lines.
2. **Premise, measured.** H1 held: the JSON arm wrote `formatRowForJson(rows[i], …)` from an unprojected read. The showcase answered 25 keys for `fields=title` before, and `{title}` after.

   The claim's no-`fields` decision rested on a falsifiable premise, which the dev measured false: the CSV default carries no `id`, and an export-then-upsert duplicated 10 records. The fork was reported, not forced. **Seat decision D** (`6238218754`): no-`fields` JSON writes the read's row, which is `QuerySchema.fields`' declared "absent = no projection" (`ExportRequestSchema` = `QuerySchema` ∩ `{format}`). Patch round 1 pins it through the real route, and a one-time mutation to option A reddens only that pin.

   **Seat check of the diff:** `pickExportKeys` is module-private and keeps own, non-`undefined` keys in list order. `fieldsExplicit` is captured before any default or projection runs, so the JSON arm reuses the one resolved column list and defines no second one.
3. **Contract review of record:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, narrowing face, an isolated agent, **PASS `6238818395` on `939c8ac1a`**, read at source with a matching `Head-sha:`. ② is right: `'@objectstack/rest': minor`, `fix(rest)!:`, `no (narrowing)` and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Triage's `yes (narrowing)` was the wrong spelling; nothing widens.
4. **Check-runs on head `939c8ac1a`** at this act: 32 success, 8 skipped, 0 other (40 runs, latest per name). `check-expected-skips --pr 24206`: OK. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check and Test Core 1–6 are success; Check Changeset is success with the breaking declaration.
5. **Accepted deviations:**
   - the no-`fields` half came in round 1, not round 0, through the declared fork path;
   - a bare `--` was dropped in the round 0 test command (it ran the whole package, no scope effect);
   - a whole-workspace build was used for the showcase measurement.

   **Changeset, read sentence by sentence:** the narrowing sentence and the "absent, not null" sentence match `pickExportKeys`. "Unchanged: `format=json` without `?fields=` still writes each row as the read returns it" is decision D. The CSV / XLSX columns are untouched, as the claim held off.
6. **Out of scope:** the CSV / XLSX default carries no `id` on an object that declares none. It matches the documented default, pre-dates #24178 and has no named consumer, so it stays in Acceptance notes with `carrier: #24183`'s decision record and is not filed. Revisit it when a named consumer needs CSV round-trip by `id`.
7. **Landing.** Ordinary queue landing, armed in this act. `Fixes #24183` closes the card on merge, and the seat strips `pm:dispatched` in the same act.
